name: Image-Conditional Triplanar Representation
definition: A 3D scene representation comprised of three axis-aligned orthogonal planes (S = [Sxy, Sxz, Syz]) that models 3D scenes with full expressivity at scale, avoiding cubic complexity of voxel-based representations and the expressiveness limitations of BEV/2D representations.
summary: Image-Conditional Triplanar Representation constructs learnable triplanes from input images and camera poses, enabling efficient sparse-view synthesis without cubic voxel complexity.
